blinding.selection_rule: All snapshot identities and strata are frozen without reading model-minus-DFT errors.
blinding.development_set: The 12-snapshot feasibility set may guide a pass, narrowing decision, or fine-tuning design; it is not the publication test set.
blinding.publication_test: The 30-snapshot publication-heldout set remains disjoint from all fine-tuning and threshold selection.
blinding.audit_note: This operational protocol was frozen after the QE/CHGNet stress-convention implementation audit and one unscored CHGNet smoke inference, but before any set-level feasibility report and before creation or DFT labelling of the 30-snapshot publication-heldout set.

sampling_release_requirements.scope: This gate authorizes only short held-out coordinate-sampling trajectories, not formal transport production or publication claims.

release_requirements.failure_action: Do not release the remaining universal-CHGNet formal trajectories. Preserve the negative result and either narrow the claim or train a separately versioned potential with a disjoint 30-snapshot held-out test.
